title.narrative: Successful waste prevention and minimization, Reuse and Recycling in Sousse and Beni Khalled: Reconciling El Tounsi with its urban environment

description.narrative:
Deliverable 1: Promoting the circular economy in waste management in the commune of Sousse Promote energy recovery programmes from organic waste produced at the wholesale market and hotel units (the establishment of anaerobic digestion units; Develop the municipal program for the recovery of green and organic waste through the production of compost for the agricultural sector (Olive oil Sector); Improve the source separation of organic waste in providing bins, color coded to distinguish them from other recyclables that might be picked up, and providing compostable bags for mixed organic waste; Reduce the quantity buried through the MBT mechanical-biological treatment system which includes mechanical sorting in the landfill for the recovery of a percentage of waste; promote investments for the installation of washing stations for plastic film, which is found in large quantities in the landfill, in the streets, in the natural environment Strengthen the initiatives of young social entrepreneurs, working in waste recovery and improve circular investments taking into account the advantages in terms of job creation; Create an information portal: create a web based centralized collection, monitoring and updated information on programs, policies, incentives, case studies, best practices and more technical documents and tools.
Delivrable 2 Collaborate with the municipality of Beni-Khalled, to initiate a City composting solution; this will allow the Development of the workforce of the municipality to understand the importance of waste sorting through the installation of a composting station in each community; develop collaboration between community and municipality. Generated compost will be sold at a small fee to farmers, and generated income will be used to improve community public spaces. Youth will be an important part of the process, as they will maintain, manage and control environment protection activities in their communities. Initiate an economic group of women home based businesses that work on citrus products generation. Deliver workshops on quality control, packaging and co-create a brand that represents the city of Beni-Khalled, in collaboration with economic group members. Lead co-design session regarding the governance and management of the economic group, short ad long term strategies. Identify opportunities for shared economy to enable group to grow once demand grows, through other homebased business or local farmers as suppliers. Collaborate with farmers union, to deliver on the farm workshops related to soil preservation, importance of biodiversity and better water resource management. Get assistance from farming experts on best land management taking into account farming sector challenges in the region, and analyses opportunities and potentially needed changes to improve farmer’s livelihoods, food security and environment protection.
